emfAttributes.Global_Title: FIA Formula 2: Where F1 Stars are Made

metadata.longDescription: In celebration of the 10th season of FIA Formula 2, we speak to the F1 drivers who have graduated from the Championship, including newly crowned World Drivers’ Champion Kimi Antonelli, to look back at the moments that made them and the Championship that moulded them into the F1 talents they are today. Hear from Team Principals Toto Wolff, Fred Vasseur and Laurent Mekies, as well as F1 President and CEO Stefano Domenicali and F2 CEO Bruno Michel, on what makes an F2 driver into a Formula 1 star.
